versions.changelog: 同步本地 1.3.0：CDP 独立 profile、--no-sandbox、卡片定位实战坑
补 ClawHub 分类标签（automation）与话题

- Initial release of **web-console-cdp-upload**.
- Automates web-based upload, publishing, and form-filling on platforms without public APIs, using local Chrome/Edge via Chrome DevTools Protocol.
- No browser installation required—reuses existing Chrome/Edge and the logged-in user profile.
- Supports file uploads to web forms by injecting files into `<input type="file">` elements.
- Minimizes dependencies (`websocket-client` only), avoids large downloads.
- Includes CLI workflow and scripting interfaces for browser detection, evaluation, screenshots, and file injection.
